exposure: increased cervical length (CL) measured in the mid-trimester
cohort: Women who delivered vaginally at Seoul National University Bundang Hospital (n=820) and Boramae Medical Center (n=509) between January 2017 and February 2019, excluding multiple pregnancies and preterm births before 37 weeks of gestation.
finding: Mid-trimester cervical length was not associated with vacuum-assisted vaginal delivery, while nulliparity was a significant risk factor.
gest_age: Median gestational age at delivery was 39.4 weeks (range, 37.0-41.6 weeks)
